property_summary: Ownership-gated actions require the immediate caller (msg.sender) to be the owner, so a transferOwnership relayed through an intermediary contract always reverts in the reference C; the tx.origin mutant accepts such relayed calls, letting a non-owner contract change owner.
change_summary: Replace 'require(msg.sender == owner);' with 'require(tx.origin == owner);' so calls originating from the owner via intermediating contracts are allowed (and direct calls from contracts by the owner are rejected).
